title: Hunting Seasons File (Jagdzeiten)
description: Shared shape for both the federal base layer (data/federal.json) and per-state delta files (data/states/*.json). The effective seasons in a state are computed by mergeSeasons(federal, state) — see src/lib/seasons.ts. State files contain ONLY deviations from the federal defaults (overrides, Landesrecht additions, ganzjährige Schonungen).

state.description: Two-letter German state code (state files only; omitted in the federal base)

name.description: Full name of the federal state (state files only)

source.description: Provenance for citation. Not authoritative legal advice.

species.description: German common name exactly as used in the regulation. Combined regulation entries (e.g. 'Dam- und Sikawild') are split into individual species so that deltas can match by (species, class).

class.description: Age/sex class wording from the regulation (e.g. 'Hirsche und Alttiere', 'Böcke', 'Schmaltiere', 'Kälber', 'Jungfüchse', 'Hennen'); null if the entry applies to the whole species. A class-level entry overrides or carves an exception out of a species-level (null) entry of the same species.

type.description: range = open during the listed periods; year-round = huntable all year (ganzjährig); closed = no open season (ganzjährige Schonzeit)

periods.description: One or more open date ranges. Omitted/empty for year-round and closed. A period wraps the year boundary when end < start.

end.description: MM-DD inclusive. '02-28' denotes end of February per the regulation wording.

conditional.description: true if hunting is permitted only under legal restrictions (e.g. only for Vergrämung/Schadensabwehr). The traffic-light UI must show this distinctly from a plain open season.

provenance.description: Set by mergeSeasons on the effective output; not stored in source files.
